limitations: This game-specific implementation remains inside the GPL-2.0-or-later Warzone extension boundary.
Terrain only. `game.map` (tiles, heights, gateways) and `ttypes.ttp` (terrain type per texture) are read; the rest of the map bundle is not.
The portable MK3 reader handles `game.map` v10-v40 terrain and the fixed `<name>.gam` header; `ttypes.ttp` remains outside this contribution's current single-source routing.

Object tables are not read: `droid.json`/`feature.json`/`struct.json` under `multiplay/maps/` (current) and `dinit.bjo`/`feat.bjo`/`struct.bjo` under `wrf/cam*/` (legacy binary, still what the campaign uses). Both representations ship in 4.7.0 and neither is a superset of the other.
Read only. Writing is not implemented.

`game.map` validates only the first three bytes of its signature — `loadMapData_Internal` never compares the trailing space — so a file beginning `map` followed by any byte is accepted, as it is by the engine. `ttypes.ttp` checks all four.

A `ttypes.ttp` declaring at least MAX_TILE_TEXTURES entries is clamped to 254 rather than rejected, reproducing the engine comment "Workaround for fugly map editor bug". The declared count is reported alongside so the discrepancy is visible.

A terrain value equal to TER_MAX passes validation, because the engine tests `> TER_MAX`. TER_MAX is a sentinel, so this is arguably an engine bug; rejecting it here would refuse files the game loads.
